question: Will United Russia win between 310 and 324 seats in the next Russian State Duma election?
thesis: Coherent completion of the United Russia seat-bracket ladder frozen 2026-08-25 (<280 q=0.015, 340-354 q=0.29, >=355 q=0.14, implied 280-324 = 0.23 and 325-339 = 0.32) and the 08-29 abstention that placed ~0.03 on 280-294. Same seat arithmetic, no new information: ~200 of 225 SMDs plus a mid-50s list share puts the central case at 335-345, so the residual 280-324 mass (0.23) splits roughly 0.03 / 0.05 / 0.15 across 280-294 / 295-309 / 310-324. The market's 20.4c on 310-324 is the bracket that CONTAINS the 2021 anchor (324), i.e. the crowd's anchoring mass, which the frozen ladder already bets against. This is NOT an independent bet: it is perfectly correlated with the 08-25 ladder and must be counted as one shot for multiple-testing. Falsifier: official UR seat count inside 310-324 (the frozen ladder's own falsifier).
